Murage keeps each bot's {engine} files in a folder of their own, and that folder could not be prepared, so the turn did not start. Your own {engine} setup was left untouched.
Check that the disk has free space and that Murage can write to its data folder, then retry.

runtimeError.local.engine-symlink-requir: {engine} cannot be linked to this bot's folder

Murage keeps each bot's {engine} files in a folder of their own and shares your {engine} sign-in with it through a file link. This computer did not allow that link, so the turn did not start. Your own {engine} setup was left untouched.
On Windows, turn on Developer Mode (Settings, System, For developers) so links can be made, then retry.
runtimeError.local.engine-login-link-los: This bot's {engine} sign-in no longer matches yours

The sign-in file in this bot's {engine} folder and your own {engine} sign-in file are no longer the same file, and Murage does not choose between two sign-ins for you, so the turn did not start. Your own {engine} setup was left untouched.
If you signed out of {engine} or replaced its sign-in file, sign in to {engine} again. If this keeps happening, turn on Developer Mode in Windows so a link can be made, then retry.
runtimeError.local.engine-config-invalid: {engine} has a setup file Murage cannot read

Murage gives each bot its own copy of your {engine} settings, and one of your {engine} setup files could not be read as valid JSON, so the turn did not start rather than run with out-of-date settings. Your own {engine} setup was left untouched.
Fix or remove the setup file in your {engine} folder, then retry.

whatsapp.groups.help: Groups are off until you turn one on. In a group set to Mention, the bot answers only when someone mentions the linked number, replies to a message the bot sent, or writes the linked number's digits without mentioning anyone else. In a group set to Every message, it answers every message. Everyone in a group, including you, is a guest there: the bot uses only that group's conversation, never personal memory, and never approves anything.
